verdicts.reason: Both break the five-flavour list into scattered pieces: Cherry Bang and Mango Boom sit big in the middle, Cola Crash is stranded under the logo at far left, and Lime Zap and Grape Pop are crammed in at tiny, unreadable sizes around the CTA. That destroys the list's order and grouping and leaves competing focal points; the can is also tiny and the 'FIZZBANG!' logo pill is cramped at the edge. B is nearly identical but makes Mango Boom larger than Cherry Bang, which makes the flavour sizes even more inconsistent, so A is marginally less bad.
